notes.title: "RESOANRK X LITE" is available on the Oculus Store (Quest / App Lab)
notes.notes:
VR Rhythm Game "RESOANRK X LITE" has been released on Oculus Store (Quest / App Lab).

Quest2(90Hz) and VRM linkage function are also supported.
Enjoy this new VR rhythm game that uses both hands!

This title is currently available on App Lab.

Please search for "RESONARK X LITE" (exact match) in the Oculus Store, or via the link below.

[url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/3405379359561787/]https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/3405379359561787/[/url]

As a function exclusive to the Oculus version, you can play games with your own avatar through DMM VR Connect ( https://connect.vrlab.dmm.com ).

Please register your VRM to your account beforehand, and then connect it from within the game.

notes.title: RESONARK X version 1.4 "Beginning of Fest" Release Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing!
In this update, we've added new songs and made some functional improvements.

[Added songs/difficulty levels]
In this update, we've added new songs and improved functionality.
The following 7 songs (x 3 difficulty levels) have been added.
* Heroes（game ver）/ Zpinkpong
* P.N.R. / はがね
* Tune your bass to ours / Ryo Arue
* The Shirushi of Untravellers / DUALYS(DRIVE.+yuugen6)
* Chase the shadow（2021 rework）/ 影虎。
* Imagination / WiredLain
* Xenophobia - Resonark Edit / Tatsh

Added difficulty levels for the following songs.
* Tutorial / Noshi [Advanced, Nightmare]

[VR Mode]
* The sound effects can now be turned on or off. The sound effects can now be turned on or off in the "In-game SE" section of the Play Preparation scene.
* More variations of clap operations. 
* When the "Clap Type" is set to "GRIP" on the Play Preparation scene, you can clap by holding the grips of both hands (GrabGrip buttons). 
* When the "Clap Type" is set to "DIST", the clap operations can be controlled by the distance between the two hands.
* Camera work behavior has been added and fixed.

[Both modes]
* The background of the performance scene has been added.

notes.title: RESONARK X version 1.3 "Submarine Pt.3"
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing!
This update includes the addition of the "VRM linking function" in VR mode.

[Track additions]
The following 5 songs (3 difficulty levels) have been added. A total of 28 songs can be played.
- Aragami / xi
- conflict / siromaru＋cranky
- Join / Tatsh feat.musica
- Voiceless Mind / musica
- PEKO PEKO BATTLE / yuugen6

[VR Mode enhancement]
Added the ability to link to VRM. Currently, it supports calling from local files and calling in cooperation with VRoid Hub ( https://hub.vroid.com/ ).

The VRM integration screen and various settings have been added. It is now possible to change the size of all the models in VR mode including the VRM model at once.

You can now change the angle of the camera that relays the performance scene in VR mode to the desktop screen.

You can select one of the following: a camera that projects the same position as the HMD, fixed cameras (two types), or an auto camera.

You can also choose whether or not to display the score panel.

notes.title: RESONARK X version 1.2 "Submarine Pt.2"
notes.notes:
RESONARK X version 1.2 "Submarine Pt.2"

This update adds some major features, including a "desktop mode" that allows you to play without VR.

[song added]
The following 5 tracks (3 difficulty levels) were added. Total of 23 tracks can be played.
[list]
[*]REDRAVE by Tatsh&NAOKI feat.Kent Alexander
[*]V.G.S by Tatsh feat.Sak&Rei
[*]NuRAVE by Tatsh
[*]IONOSTREAM by Tatsh
[*]Blue Te1egraph by yuugen6
[/list]

[Desktop mode performance screen]
- You can now play 7 lanes + α with 8 keys in "Desktop Mode".

[Desktop mode config screen]
- You can use the "Key Config" function to customize the keys used in performance to some extent.
- You can now increase or decrease the threshold of the clapping distance according to the size of the frame.

[VR mode performance scene]
- The larger the frame of the frame, the farther away your hands are, the more you are considered to have clapped.
　- This feature was added because the Oculus Quest2 controller was larger than before. If you have a larger controller, try making the frame larger.

[Both mode performance scene]
- You can now share the results directly from the result screen by linking your account to Twitter. You can now post the result directly from the result screen to Twitter by linking your account to the Twitter integration screen in the settings.
- The screenshot function was added. In the result screen, you can click "Screenshot / Tweet" button for VR or press the → key for desktop to save the result image in the picture folder.

notes.title: RESONARK X version 1.1 "Submarine Pt.1"
notes.notes:
RESONARK X version 1.1 "Submarine" release notes

Thanks to your positive feedback, we have our first big update!

[song added]
The following 8 tracks (3 difficulty levels) were added. Total of 18 tracks can be played.
　・Cloud Identifier by memex
　・水際 (Re-Install The Ghost) - Resonark Edit by 八月二雪，obake
　・Underwater - Resonark Edit by upusen
　・Variant Cross by M-UE
　・Murder Prison by M-UE
　・Domination by M-UE
　・Bone Born Bomb by M-UE
　・Plague Mask by M-UE

[Entire game]
The game flow was reviewed and the music selection screen and the performance screen were separated.
You can now adjust the scroll rate and frame on the performance screen and other settings on the song selection screen.

The behavior of the desktop camera on the song selection and performance screens was adjusted.

[Performance screen]
We have implemented a skin system that allows you to play on the stage that matches the song. Currently, you can see 4 skins: one for Tutorial, one for Cloud Identifier, one for RESONARK, and one for RESONARK 2 (skins are automatically selected according to the song). The skin can now be fixed to "RESONARK" in the song selection screen.
We adjust the size of the string collider to match the size of the frame.

[Song selection screen]
We have implemented a song list system to improve the list of songs. You can now check the difficulty and clear status of 8 songs at a time.

notes.title: Fixed Update Information
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing!
This is the information about the update "RESONARK X version r1.0.1".

[b]Performance[/b]
In order to contribute to a better feeling of playing...
- The blue object's front detection was narrowed.
- Judgment of the purple object was narrowed.

[b]Config[/b]
In order to contribute to increased convenience...
- You can now change the frame radius.
- The granularity of the frame height adjustment was made finer.

[b]Song selection[/b]
In order to contribute to increased convenience, The lamp to show the clearing status was added.
　Gray: not played
　White: Already in play
　Blue: Full Combo
　Orange: all perfect
　The color below takes precedence over the color below.
